svg.title: The Drowned Tower: DM map
svg.text: Lamp Station Nine, on the Isle of Old Stone (hex D2). Module 2. Players never see this sheet.

g.text: south: the Shallows; The Fort, 12 miles
C3 flooded stair — G6 (swim, or drain at C10)
S5 knotted rope — G1 ledge (50 ft)
G8 Door — sealed; leads nowhere in Module 2

svg.text: at lake level, under the north cliff

g.text: open lake · the Deep lies north
The channel runs from the cave mouth
(G1) past the dock (G2) into the pool
(G7). The Warden can swim all of it.
Dry way round the pool: from the feeding
ledge (G2) the rim ledge runs round the
south and west sides, past G6, and up
the north arm to G8 under the cliff.
G8 can also be reached by swimming the
north arm. The Warden can swim it too.
G4 is reached only by the plank bridge.

svg.text: Original map for The Drowned Tower. Art rule: Otus ink.
